record.question: The crops are dying, it __________ rained.
record.explanation: Answer C: must not have. “Must not have rained” is the grammatical negative perfect modal; “must not have been rained” is ungrammatical in this intransitive use. Independent check: A present inference about the absence of rain is “it must not have rained”; the perfect infinitive follows must. Reference: https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar/must. Verified worked solution, unofficial.
